statements.markdown: **Proposition 1.2 (realising finite monotone witness rules).** *Let $E$ be a finite set of primes, and let $\mathcal U$ be an upward-closed family of subsets of $E$ with $E\in\mathcal U$ and $\varnothing\notin\mathcal U$. There is a set $A_{\mathcal U}\subseteq\mathbb N_{>0}$ with $\sum_{a\in A_{\mathcal U}}1/a=\infty$ such that, for every integer $b\ge2$ and every finite set $\mathcal P$ of primes,* $$ W_{b,\mathcal P}(A_{\mathcal U})<\infty \quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \mathcal P\cap E\in\mathcal U. \tag{12} $$ *Moreover $X_B(b)$ is irrational for every infinite $B\subseteq A_{\mathcal U}$ and every integer $b\ge2$.*
